summary: Frontend-only visual review of Pharmacy Portal → Incoming Prescriptions PATIENT INFORMATION panel. Logged in as snapdemoa8ef8d (Partner login), verified compact Incoming list, opened BAGNASCO GONZALEZ Rx (RXTX-000067), inspected patient info panel including new 'as of' note and grouped OHIP formatting. All requested visual tweaks are in place. One gap: prescription-level '3 months / 0 refills' is not rendered in the Prescription card.

ui_bugs.issue: Prescription-level duration (3 months) and refills (0) are not displayed. Only per-medication quantity/refills is templated (line 106), but the sample rx has no per-med quantity/refills so nothing renders. The review checklist explicitly asks for prescription-level '3 months / 0 refills'.

verified_items: Partner login (/signin?partner=1) with snapdemoa8ef8d/SnapDemo123! → lands on /pharmacy without password-change screen.
Incoming list is COMPACT with headers exactly [Patient, Physician, Sent, Rx, PDF, Status]; row shows '2 medication(s)' and no address/OHIP/phone.

Patient Information panel (incoming-patient-info) shows: Name 'BAGNASCO GONZALEZ, Maria Esther'; DOB '1952 Apr - 29'; VIEN PIN 1951; OHIP '1572 035 465' with 'VH' as separate span (ml-2 gives visible space) and 'exp 2027 Apr - 29'; Address '3174 Bathurst Street, Unit 5B' / 'Toronto, ON, M6A 2B1'; Phone Cell '(647) 555-0100' / Home '(416) 555-0111'.
incoming-patient-ohip data-testid present and returns '1572 035 465  VH · exp 2027 Apr - 29'.

incoming-patient-asof data-testid present, text 'Patient information as of 2026 Sep - 28 · 8:37 PM', class 'text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-2' → subtle grey/informational, NOT red/amber, no 'snapshot' term.
Prescription section shows two distinct medication cards: 'Rosuvastatin calcium 20 mg tablet' with SIG '1 tablet OD' and 'Bisoprolol fumarate 5 mg tablet' with SIG '1 tablet HS'.
Prescriber section shows 'Dr. Pablo Aguayo' + 'TEST Clinic Name' + Sent timestamp.
Patient info card and medication cards are visually distinct (separate white bordered cards, side-by-side).
action_items: Consider surfacing prescription-level duration '3 months' and 'Refills 0' either at the top of the Prescription card or per medication (populate m.quantity/m.refills or add rx-level fields). Currently line 106 renders nothing because the sample med objects lack quantity/refills.
critical_code_review_comments: fmtOhip is display-only and correctly falls back to raw value for non 10-digit inputs; version code is a separate span with ml-2 for spacing (renders visually spaced although innerText concatenates without a literal space — acceptable).
As-of note uses detail.sent_at, subtle text-slate-400 text-[11px] — matches spec.
PharmacyIncoming.jsx is 181 lines, well within size guidelines.
